subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and viewer authorization model for usage reporting now, or should user-dimensional billing and quota reporting wait for broader Gateway principal/authorship work?
rationale: Source inspection shows usage totals and some origin metadata, but no canonical identity, aggregation, retention, or authorization contract suitable for billing-grade per-user views.

options.title: Define core accounting subject
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

options.title: Wait for principal design
options.body: Keep this open but block implementation until Gateway multi-principal and per-message author attribution semantics are settled.

options.title: External or plugin-only for now
options.body: Document current usage exports and plugin diagnostics as the supported path for custom spend dashboards until core has multi-user direction.

recommendation.title: Define core accounting subject
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses usage reporting, Gateway security, provider billing, and Dashboard surfaces where steipete has the strongest recent history.
